'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**Thousands of [[prison escape|prisoners escape]] from the National Penitentiary in [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]], after it was stormed by armed gangs. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-68462851 (BBC News)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/03/02/americas/prisoners-escape-port-au-prince-prison-haiti-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
**Haiti declares a [[state of emergency]] in response to the attacks on the country's two largest prisons. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/mar/04/haiti-mass-jailbreak-violence-port-au-prince-gangs (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Islamic State insurgency in the North Caucasus]]
**[[Spetsnaz|Russian special forces]] conduct a [[counter-terrorism]] operation in [[Karabulak, Republic of Ingushetia|Karabaluk]], [[Republic of Ingushetia]], [[Russia]], killing six militants. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-security-forces-battle-militants-ingushetia-region-russian-media-report-2024-03-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Pakistan floods]]
**Thirty-six people are killed and 50 others are injured across [[Pakistan]] by heavy rainfall, which has also caused [[landslide]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-rains-snowfall-deaths-landslides-af61fb4499a5ad30b8fe83b134b22826 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*At least four people are killed and three others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a house party in [[King City, California|King City]], [[California]], [[United States|U.S.]]. Three suspects are arrested and unharmed.[https://www.cnn.com/2024/03/04/us/four-dead-california-king-city-party-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*One woman killed and twelve others injured in a mass shooting at a night club in [[West Point, Mississippi]], U.S. Suspect(s) remains at large. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/03/03/us/mississippi-west-point-club-shooting/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[2024 Republican Party presidential primaries]]
***Former [[United States Ambassador to the United Nations|U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations]] [[Nikki Haley]] wins the [[Washington, D.C.]] [[2024 District of Columbia Republican presidential primary|primary]], making it her first win in the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican Party]] contest.  [https://www.axios.com/2024/03/04/nikki-haley-wins-republican-primary-washington-dc (Axios)]
*[[2024 Belgrade City Assembly election]]
**A rerun of the [[2023 Belgrade City Assembly election|2023 Belgrade election]] is called amid [[2023–2024 Serbian election protests|protests]] following reports of irregularities in the election. [https://apnews.com/article/serbia-election-belgrade-opposition-adf6f5b21e020d27bda986a366c64a8c (AP)]
*[[2024 Pakistani general election]]
**[[Shehbaz Sharif]] is elected as [[Prime Minister of Pakistan]] for a second term. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistans-shehbaz-sharif-set-take-oath-prime-minister-second-term-2024-03-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Salvadoran general election]]
**[[Salvadorans]] elect all 44 mayors and municipal councils and all 20 deputies to the [[Central American Parliament]]. [https://diario.elmundo.sv/politica/arrancan-elecciones-municipales-y-de-parlacen-con-algunos-atrasos-y-disputas (''El Mundo'')]
*[[2024 Swiss referendums]]
**Voters in [[Switzerland]] accept the referendum to increase monthly [[pension]]s but reject the referendum to increase the [[retirement age]]. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/swiss-politics/swiss-vote-on-higher-pensions-and-retiring-later/73175615 (Swissinfo)]
